title: Naturality of uncurrying on an arbitrary scheme tensor summand
statement: For any scheme Y, module-sheaf cochain complexes P,F,V and f:Tot(F tensor V) to Hom(P,F), restrict schemeTensorHomUncurry of f followed by Hom(P,eta_F) through the p,q inner inclusion and n,r outer inclusion, where p+q=n and n+r=k. The result is the braiding of F^p tensor V^q and P^r followed by tensorHomEquiv.symm applied to the inner inclusion, f in degree n and the Hom projection in degrees n,r,k, followed by eta_F in degree k. V is arbitrary and no ordinary evaluation predicate is assumed.

source.place: Tags 08DJ (lemma-internal-hom), 08DM and 08DQ; ordinary evaluation localization proof step 2

proof.text: Use the outer component equation and its explicit projection formula. Apply projection naturality with identity on P and the resolution map on F, cancel the identity via functoriality, and use tensor-Hom naturality in the second tensor factor and target together with braiding naturality. Proved private abstract helpers keep the chosen Hom functor irreducible during this calculation; its projection formula is exposed once by reflexivity.

theorem schemeTensorHomUncurry_summand_naturality (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (P F V : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (f : pullbackTensorTotal Y F V ⟶ homComplex (R := Y.sheaf) P F)
    (p q r n k : ℤ) (hpq : p + q = n) (hnr : n + r = k) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.isGrothendieckAbelian (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
    let eta := CochainComplex.toKInjectiveResolution.{u}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))
    let π := Classical.choose (homComplex_projections_exists.{u, u, u, u} (R := Y.sheaf))
    (HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor F V (curriedTensor _) (.up ℤ) p q n hpq ▷ P.X r)
      ≫ HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor (pullbackTensorTotal Y F V) P
        (curriedTensor _) (.up ℤ) n r k hnr ≫
          (schemeTensorHomUncurry Y (pullbackTensorTotal Y F V) P F
            (f ≫ ((homComplexFunctor (R := Y.sheaf)).obj (op P)).map (eta.app F))).f k =
    (β_ (F.X p ⊗ V.X q) (P.X r)).hom ≫
      (SheafOfModules.tensorHomEquiv (R := Y.sheaf) (P.X r) (F.X p ⊗ V.X q)
        (F.X k)).symm
        (HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor F V (curriedTensor _) (.up ℤ) p q n hpq ≫
          f.f n ≫ π P F n r k (by omega)) ≫ (eta.app F).f k
